title: Rearrange Array Elements by Sign
summary: Given an even-length array of integers with an equal number of positive and negative values, rearrange the array so that every consecutive pair of integers has opposite signs, maintaining the original order for integers of the same sign, and starting with a positive integer.
statement: Given an even-length array of integers with an equal number of positive and negative values, rearrange the array so that every consecutive pair of integers has opposite signs, maintaining the original order for integers of the same sign, and starting with a positive integer.
constraints: nums has even length, equally many positive and negative values, and no zeros.
Output signs alternate beginning positive while preserving relative order within each sign.
Return the uniquely determined rearranged array.
hints: The output is the stable interleaving of the positive subsequence and negative subsequence.
Collect each sign in original order, then append one positive and one negative repeatedly.
Equal sign counts fill every output position, and stable extraction plus interleaving enforces both order and alternation.
editorial: Equal sign counts fill every output position, and stable extraction plus interleaving enforces both order and alternation.

tests.explanation: Stable positive order 3,1,2 interleaves with negative order -2,-5,-4.
The positive value moves first, producing [1,-1].
